summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing board approval of an out-of-court restructuring proceeding (Recuperação Extrajudicial) in Brazil and a Chapter 15 petition in the U.S. for itself and certain subsidiaries. The filing includes the restructuring plan and protective measures. No specific terms, such as debt amounts or stakeholder treatment, were disclosed. The board unanimously approved the filing, following a favorable recommendation from the Executive Board and Finance and Investment Committee. Watch for creditor negotiations, plan confirmation, and U.S. recognition proceedings.
